repo_notes.content: Jekyll plugin (Ruby gem) that generates a JSON search index at build time for client-side search. Supports three engines: MiniSearch, ElasticLunr, and a semantic cosine-similarity adapter over pre-computed embeddings.

Browser runtime uses a base + adapter architecture: client-search-base.js owns form wiring, DOM rendering, and the two-stage strategy (exact AND with prefix/boosting first, fuzzy OR fallback). Each adapter is a pure translator to the engine's native API — the semantic adapter is the exception (cosine similarity, no AND/OR).

Embeddings are generated at build time via a local Ollama server (ollama-ruby, lazy-loaded optional dep). IndexCache stores content-hash-keyed vectors so unchanged documents are not re-embedded. fail_on_error:true fails the build by default.
Liquid tags: {% search_form %}, {% search_dropdown %} (navbar live search), {% related_articles %} (build-time similarity cutoff analysis via RelatedAnalyzer).
passthrough_fields config lets other plugins (e.g. jekyll-documents) forward document data fields into the index; rendered as data-* attributes for CSS customization.
See AGENTS.md and README.developer.md for full conventions and release process.
